display_long_description:
A highly detailed realistic Airplane, Helicopter and Drone Flight Simulator for beginner and intermediate flying learning students and VR enthusiast virtual pilots. Detailed cockpit panel gauges and buttons of real Trainer Airplane model with complete functionality and flying operations. Ideal for learning Flying from very basics with step-by-step guide that lets you taxi, take-off and land on a beautiful real Island Airport.

The application uses freely moving VR controller Hand-gestures. You can turn on/off or operate various toggle switches and control. The tutorial mode explains each and every gauge function and use with audio and virtual markings.

You can select to fly in all the famous cities of the worlds of all countries and enjoy flying around 3D real world maps including satellite image height maps of terrains and actual 3d buildings etc.

The class-room mode explains different theoretical aspects of flying basics help you learn how planes fly. The hanger mode let you walk around the plane while each and every part is explained in animation.

Sit, in cockpit and learn to fly by step-by-step instructions and test your skills with different flying challenges.
